# Utilitaires

Démo : https://lively-cliff-018a9540f.azurestaticapps.net/bases/utilitaires

Classes d'affichage : `utd-d-*`, `utd-hidden`, `utd-no-wrap`.

## Autres références

### Classes utilitaires

| Nom | Description |
|---|---|
| `utd-d-block` | display: block |
| `utd-d-inline` | display: inline |
| `utd-d-flex` | display: flex |
| `utd-d-table` | display: table |
| `utd-d-table-row` | display: table-row |
| `utd-d-table-cell` | display: table-cell |
| `utd-d-none` | display: none |
| `utd-hidden` | visibility: hidden |
| `utd-no-wrap` | white-space: no-wrap |
